purpose: Convert the approved-later anonymous assignment design into a deterministic controlled mapping without manually swapping participants into slots.
Fail closed when topic competence, authorship conflict, prior exposure, calibration, consent, availability, or authorization evidence is incomplete.
Preserve the 12-position, 48-critique, 96-initial-rating and no-repeat-pair arithmetic of the current preferred design.
Produce a privacy-safe public commitment summary while keeping participant, position, critique, and assignment identifiers in private controlled storage.

source_boundary.primary_reference: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments
reference_observations: The reference dataset is strongly concentrated in one primary rater, motivating a deliberately multi-rater follow-on workflow.
The reference hides source and tags during rating but notes that source and writing style may remain inferable, so assignment cannot substitute for item-level cue controls.
The reference preserves original ratings after object-level reconsideration; this assignment contract does not alter the append-only rating-record rule.

constraint_policy.topic_competence: A participant may receive a position only when its topic family appears in that participant's approved topic-family record.
constraint_policy.conflicts: A participant may not receive a position listed in their conflict record.
constraint_policy.prior_exposure: A participant may not receive a position listed in their prior-exposure record.
constraint_policy.infeasible_result: Stop with no assignment. Do not ignore, downgrade, or silently remove a competence, conflict, exposure, or balance constraint.
constraint_policy.graph_change_boundary: If the preferred graph is infeasible, Q-006B must approve a versioned graph or source-mix change before controlled assignment is retried.

deterministic_algorithm.participant_order: Sort controlled participant IDs lexicographically before enumeration.
deterministic_algorithm.candidate_mappings: Enumerate all 6! bijections from confirmed participants to R1-R6.
deterministic_algorithm.feasibility_filter: Retain only mappings satisfying topic competence, conflict, prior-exposure, and frozen graph constraints for all twelve positions.
deterministic_algorithm.selection: Hash the secret assignment seed plus each canonical feasible mapping and select the lexicographically smallest hash, with canonical mapping text as a deterministic tiebreak.
deterministic_algorithm.seed_publication: Publish only the seed hash, never the raw controlled seed.

public_summary_may_include: methodology, seed, input, and selected-mapping hashes
public_summary_must_exclude: exact feasible-mapping count for controlled assignments
